slides: Your muscles don’t care about your schedule.
They respond to the *next* load you give them.
Add just 2% more weight or reps each week.
That tiny increase compounds into massive strength.
Consistency + micro‑progress = unstoppable growth.
Decision fatigue is the silent saboteur.
Every trivial choice drains willpower.
Pre‑define your defaults for the day.
When the default aligns with your goal, no energy is spent.
Automate good choices; reserve will for the big moves.
You can’t out‑train a bad night’s sleep.
Growth hormone spikes in the first deep‑sleep cycles.
Interruptions cut that surge by half.
Prioritize a wind‑down routine and consistent bedtime.
Better sleep = stronger lifts, sharper mind.
Future you is a mirror of today’s actions.
Identity isn’t declared, it’s built daily.
Choose actions that a proud version of you would approve.
When the present self feels like a rehearsal, motivation becomes automatic.
Live as the person you aim to become, not as the person you think you are.
